author: M. L. Colon
title: Rep. Keith Self urges Senate action on DHS funding and criticizes Sharia law
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives, posted several statements on March 30, 2026, criticizing the Senate’s handling of Department of Homeland Security (DHS) funding and expressing concerns about Sharia law in relation to the U.S. Constitution.
In one post, Self cited John Adams and made comments regarding constitutional values: “As John Adams warned, ‘Our Constitution was made only for a moral and religious people. It is wholly inadequate to the government of any other.’ Sharia is totally opposed to the U.S. Constitution. Sharia has no place in America.” (March 30, 2026).
Later that day, he addressed legislative actions taken by the House: “The House has passed funding for ALL of DHS FOUR TIMES. The House passed the SAVE America Act almost 50 days ago. The Senate needs to cancel their 2-week recess, return to Washington ASAP, and finish the job. The American people are watching!” (March 30, 2026).
He continued his criticism regarding Senate recess and security issues: “The Senate should not be taking a two-week vacation while the Department of Homeland Security remains unfunded and our elections remain unsecured. They need to get back to Washington, DC, right away and get to work. Fully fund DHS — including ICE and CBP. Pass the SAVE America” (March 30, 2026).
Keith Self has previously secured electoral victories over Sandeep Srivastava in both recent congressional races; in 2024 he won with approximately 62.5% of votes compared to Srivastava’s 37.6%, and in 2022 he achieved a similar margin with about 60.5% support.
